notes.title: Rosemary's Fate Major Update 2025 & promo
notes.notes: [p]Patch Notes:[/p][p]We’ve added an [b]animated compass[/b] in the bottom right corner to help you navigate the audio-visual locations more easily. This [b]new feature[/b] makes the [b]gameplay[/b] smoother and more intuitive.[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, we’re offering a limited-time [b]75% discount[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support and valuable feedback. [b]Rosemary’s Fate[/b] keeps evolving — [b]join us[/b] and see what’s next![/p]

notes.title: Rosemary's Fate Major Update 2024
notes.notes:
[h3]Full notes:[/h3]

• [b]15 New Achievements.[/b] Collect them of your journey through the dark. 

• [b]Location Selection.[/b] Now you can choose location to continue your adventure. 

• [b]Locations re-design.[/b] We've listened to your feedback and enhancing both 
navigation and audio cues to enrich experience in some locations. 

• Some other bugs fixed and polished code. 

Thank you for your continuous support and feedback. 
We're still developing [b]Rosemary`s Fate![/b]

notes.title: Update Notes #1
notes.notes:
- Added support for Subtitles in Options,
- You can choose between English and Polish subtitles.
